sources.reason: Lists the Junior Nuggets youth basketball leagues, run with the Denver Nuggets in winter, spring and fall for grades 1–8. Also lists T-ball, volleyball, girls flag football, wiffleball and the Lil Dunksters beginner basketball program. Basketball players get a jersey and a Nuggets game ticket.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – School Age Day Camp
sources.reason: Summer day camp for ages 6–11 at Northglenn Recreation Center, with swimming, field trips and pedal boats. The current page still shows Summer 2026 details, when residents could register from early December. Watch it for Summer 2027 registration, which may follow the same timing.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – Roving Recreation (teen summer trips)
sources.reason: Summer weekday day trips for teens. The page says early registration opens in the Winter/Spring Activity Guide and the final schedule goes online in late May 2027.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – Grades 6-8 Programs
sources.reason: Middle school programs, including after-school drop-in at the recreation center and the Youth Afterschool Transportation shuttle. The page lists the schedule each semester with course codes.

sources.name: Denver Zoo Conservation Alliance – Community Free Days
sources.reason: Official page listing the zoo's 2026 free days and when tickets for each are released. Tickets are online only, up to 5 per registration. The remaining days are Nov 11, 14 and 22.

sources.name: Denver Zoo – Things to Do / events
sources.reason: Official zoo events calendar with dated seasonal events, for example Fall at DZCA through Oct 31 and Zoo Lights from Nov 23, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027.

sources.name: Denver Botanic Gardens – Public Events
sources.reason: Official list of public events at York Street and Chatfield, including holiday lights such as Blossoms of Light and Trail of Lights.

sources.name: Westminster Library Adventure Pass – Butterfly Pavilion
sources.reason: Westminster library pass for free Butterfly Pavilion admission, with up to 4 extra guests at $5 each. Two passes are available per day and you reserve online.

sources.name: SCFD – Free Days events calendar
sources.reason: Calendar from the Scientific and Cultural Facilities District listing free days at SCFD-funded cultural places in the metro area.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Mile High Holidays
sources.reason: Official tourism guide to Denver holiday events with 2026 dates, including Parade of Lights, the Mile High Tree and Zoo Lights.

sources.name: Adams 12 Five Star Schools – District Calendar
sources.reason: The official district calendar. It lists no-school days, academic dates by level, school board meetings and community events for Adams 12, which serves Westminster, Thornton and Northglenn families.

sources.name: Adams County Events & Public Meetings
sources.reason: The official Adams County calendar of festivals, concerts, community activities and public meetings. It shows upcoming dates through late October 2026, including a Trunk or Treat on Oct 23.

sources.name: Adams County Parks, Open Space & Cultural Arts – Special Events
sources.reason: Main page for the county's yearly community events at Riverdale Regional Park (Pride, Stars & Stripes on July 3, the County Fair and Festival Latino). Check it for 2027 save-the-date and vendor news.

sources.name: Adams County Cultural Council Calendar
sources.reason: The county arts council's yearly meeting and grant calendar. It is useful for adults who want to follow local arts funding and get involved; the next cycle usually starts in March.

sources.name: CSU Extension – Adams County events
sources.reason: CSU Extension's event listings for Adams County: the fair, 4-H contests and youth activities at the Adams County Fairgrounds.

events.title: Northglenn Roving Recreation 2027 – early registration (Winter/Spring Activity Guide) and final schedule release
events.why: Summer trip program for teens. Early registration opens when the Winter/Spring guide comes out, and the final 2027 schedule is due online in late May 2027.

events.title: Northglenn School Age Day Camp – Summer 2027 registration
events.why: No 2027 date is posted yet. Summer 2026 registration opened Dec 8, 2025 for residents and Dec 15, 2025 for non-residents, so 2027 may open around early-to-mid December 2026.

events.title: Junior Nuggets Youth Basketball – winter league registration
events.why: Winter season of the Northglenn and Denver Nuggets co-ed league for grades 1–8. Saturday games include a Nuggets jersey and a game ticket, and registration usually comes before winter.

events.title: Denver Zoo Free Day Wed Nov 11 – tickets released Oct 28
events.why: Free admission, but tickets are limited and online only. Book on Oct 28 for the Nov 11 free day.

events.title: Denver Zoo Free Day Sat Nov 14 – tickets released Oct 31
events.why: A free Saturday zoo visit for families. Tickets come out Oct 31 and go fast.

events.title: Denver Zoo Free Day Sun Nov 22 – tickets released Nov 8
events.why: The last zoo free day of 2026. Tickets open Nov 8.

events.title: Zoo Lights tickets on sale (members Nov 2, public Nov 5)
events.why: Holiday lights at the zoo on select nights from Nov 23 to Jan 3. Value nights cost less, and children 2 and under are free.

events.title: Zoo Lights 2026–27 opening night
events.why: A long-running Denver holiday tradition with more than 3 million lights. Closed Thanksgiving and Christmas.

events.title: Blossoms of Light – public tickets on sale
events.why: Public tickets go on sale Monday Nov 9 at 10 a.m. Buy only on the official site. The event runs Nov 20 to Jan 10, closed Nov 26 and Dec 25.

events.title: Blossoms of Light opens at York Street
events.why: Holiday light display at Denver Botanic Gardens, open 4:30 to 9 p.m.

events.title: Blossoms of Light Sensory-Friendly Night
events.why: Lights and sound are turned down and fewer people are let in, for families with sensory sensitivities. Tuesday Dec 1, 5 to 8 p.m.

events.title: Trail of Lights at Chatfield Farms
events.why: Holiday lights trail run by the Botanic Gardens at Chatfield Farms. Tickets only from the official site. The page doesn't give a date.

events.title: Mile High Tree on Auraria Campus (free)
events.why: A free 110-foot tree with a lights-and-music show, open Nov 20 to Dec 31, 2026.

events.title: 9NEWS Parade of Lights downtown Denver
events.why: Free parade with lit-up floats, giant balloons, marching bands and Santa. Grandstand seats are sold separately.

events.title: ACSO Trunk or Treat at Clear Creek Valley Park (4:00–6:00 pm)
events.why: A free Halloween Trunk or Treat run by the Adams County Sheriff's Office near Westminster. Good for kids and families.

events.title: Adams County Planning Commission meeting
events.why: A public meeting at the Adams County Government Center for adults who follow local development and land-use decisions.

events.title: Adams County Fair (watch for 2027 dates)
events.why: The yearly 5-day fair at Riverdale Regional Park in Brighton, with a carnival, 4-H, live entertainment and a free shuttle. The 2026 fair ran July 29–Aug 2; 2027 dates aren't announced yet but should be at the same time of year.
